linkedActor.label: Vampire
linkedActor.hint: The character whose Shadow you play.

notes.label: Notes
notes.hint: Notes about your Shadow and the character whose Shadow you play …

aleaIactaEst.name: Alea iacta est
aleaIactaEst.effect: Turn a regular failure into a Bestial Failure, as the Abyss drives the Beast. You do not gain +1 Fear for it.

cloudTheMind.name: Cloud the Mind
cloudTheMind.effect: The Discipline fades into the Abyss and its effect does not occur. (The Rouse Check is still made.)

sowDoubt.name: Sow Doubt
sowDoubt.effect: Force the vampire to reroll up to three regular dice. Hunger dice cannot be rerolled. The Shadow chooses the dice.

hungerOfTheVoid.name: Hunger of the Void
hungerOfTheVoid.effect: The vampire immediately gains 1 Hunger as the Abyss drains her Vitae.

fataMorgana.name: Fata Morgana of Shadows
fataMorgana.effect: The Shadow distorts the vampire's perception of reality. For the rest of the scene she might see an enemy as a beloved Touchstone, hear the voice of her dead Sire, or perceive a safe haven as a traumatic place from her past. The Storyteller decides on the illusion together with the Shadow.

frenzyOfTheDamned.name: Frenzy of the Damned
frenzyOfTheDamned.effect: Forces an immediate Frenzy check (Fear / Rage).

Notify.NotEnoughAngst: Not enough Fear for this Move.
Notify.NoPermission: You do not have permission to open this sheet.
